summary.text: Kip Diggs is a Democratic state representative from the 2nd Barnstable District who took office in January 2021 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He has worked as a construction inspector and a professional boxer.

paragraphs.text: Kip Diggs lives in Osterville, Massachusetts, according to Ballotpedia.
His career experience includes working as a construction inspector and as a professional boxer.
Diggs assumed office on January 6, 2021, succeeding Republican William Crocker Jr.

For 2025-2026 he was assistant vice chair of the House Ways and Means Committee and of the Ways and Means Joint Committee, and was also assigned to the Health Care Financing and Housing joint committees and the Joint Committee on Racial Equity, Civil Rights, and Inclusion.
He advanced from the Democratic primary on September 1, 2026.
